title: Finding gray hairs in your 20s
and blaming what you eat?
The food angle is mostly a myth.
What Really Drives Early Graying

items.name: Why Hair Goes Gray
body: Pigment is made inside the follicle,
not added from the outside
With age the follicle makes less melanin —
and how early that starts is
largely down to your genes

items.name: Factor 1: Smoking
body: The habit with the clearest signal
In one study of 207 adults, smokers were
about 2.5 times more likely to have
gray hair before the age of 30

items.name: What Helps With Factor 1
body: Quitting is the one lifestyle change
with a repeatedly reported link
Nobody can promise it turns hair back —
but the rest of the benefits are real

items.name: Factor 2: Stress and Alcohol
body: Higher perceived stress tracked with
more severe graying in a 1,119-person survey
A 2020 Nature study found a mechanism —
but that experiment was done in mice

items.name: What Helps With Factor 2
body: Manage sleep, workload and alcohol
for their own sake first
Any effect on pigment is a bonus,
not something to count on

items.name: The Supplement Myth
body: MedlinePlus is blunt about this:
supplements and vitamins will not
stop or slow the rate of graying
No over-the-counter product
has been shown to restore pigment

items.name: When to Get It Checked
body: Graying before 25 plus fatigue, feeling
cold, weight gain or memory trouble?
Ask for thyroid and vitamin B12 tests —
both were significantly more common
in one series of early-graying patients

headline: Genes and age set the timetable,
habits nudge it a little
The food list you were sold
is not where the evidence is
tip: Quit smoking, keep alcohol modest, and get
B12 and thyroid checked if it started very early
